'''Greyson Thompson''' (also published as '''Grayson Thompson''') played the [[2017 U.S. National Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ 2017 U.S. National Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> Greyson Thompson also played at [[2002 Atlanta DPC]] in April 2002 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-29-nightmares-and-dreamscapes-atlanta-dpcd3619/ nightmares-and-dreamscapes-atlanta-dpc], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 29 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-29-nightmares-and-dreamscapes-atlanta-dpcd3619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
